ObEvalCtx is built per call with `ObEvalCtx::new_scope(exec, exprs, res_arena, |ctx| ..)` and never stored. Every C++ holder that keeps one across calls changes in its own row: ObOperator::eval_ctx_ (ob_operator.h:573), ObPL's eval_ctx_ (ob_pl.h:648), ObDhRangeDistWf (ob_dh_range_dist_wf.h:145), the DAS ObEvalCtx&/* members, and ObTempExprCtx: it derives from ObEvalCtx and is cached in the exec ctx's own temp_expr_ctx_map_, i.e. an exec ctx -> ObTempExprCtx -> exec_ctx_ self-reference. That cache keeps only the per-temp-expr data (frame_cnt_ and frames, expr_op_ctx_store_, expr_op_size_) under an id of the ObTempExpr instead of its address (R4/§2.5), loses the ObEvalCtx base, and ObTempExpr::eval builds the ObEvalCtx per evaluation with new_scope after installing the cached frames/store (ObTempExprCtxReplaceGuard); api/07 has no shape for this cache (amendment). sql call sites `ctx.exec_ctx_.f(..)` (599) -> `ctx.exec_ctx::<ObExecContext>().f(..)`; an eval that must run operators uses `ctx.with_exec_ctx(|exec| ..)`.
